title: Letters and Bakery
author: Odile Yarrow
blurb: Juniper Thornbury, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
